duplicateHeaders.message: Section 'K.accept' renders the header 'close_roc5' at columns 2 and 5 — a header must identify exactly one column so conditions and Market Read markers can address it. Two columns of one metric are distinguished only by a read-shaping parameter the header carries: a non-zero offset, or a Developing read. To keep both lanes of one metric, mark one column Developing so its header carries '_dev' — Confirmed is the unmarked lane, so leaving it to the frame-relative default collides with it.
